titleStmt.title: List of the documents referred to in the foregoing “memorandum.”

head.hi: List of the documents referred to in the foregoing “memorandum.”

list.label: 1st.
list.item: Copy of articles from the Regeneracion.
list.label: 2d.
list.item: A letter from the Paraguayan citizen, Eduardo Aramburu, dated April 1, 1869.
list.label: 3d.
list.item: Another letter from the same, dated January 30, 1870.
list.label: 4th.
list.item: Statement of Madam Dorothée Lasserre.
list.label: 5th.
list.item: Deposition of the Italian subjects, Catalina Boeroaode Aehimeli, Joao Estevōa Chiapella, José Ponzio, &c.
list.label: 6th.
list.item: Statement of D. Francisco Lopez de Leite Pereira, and of D. Marianna Dolores Pereira.
list.label: 7th.
list.item: A list, by name, of the foreigners assassinated by order of Lopez.
list.label: 8th.
list.item: Deposition of thirty foreigners.
list.label: 8th bis.
list.item: Narrative.
list.label: 9th.
list.item: Ditto of the Italian, Antonio Montero.
list.label: 10th.
list.item: Ditto of Angelo Benites.
list.label: 11th.
list.item: Ditto of other residents in Paraguay.
list.label: 12th.
list.item: Letter of D. Rozalia Domeq Concepcion Decond.
list.label: 13th.
list.item: Declaration of Madam Lasserre.
list.label: 14th.
list.item: Information furnished by the Duke of Caxias, July 1, 1869.
list.label: 15th.
list.item: Inventory of the articles” of gold and silver found in the churches of Caacupé and Perebebuy, and in the house of the mother of the Dictator Lopez, and also of those collected by the Brazilian forces in the Cordillera of Ascurza.
list.label: 16th.
list.item: Reply of the provisional government to the notes received from the special mission of Brazil which related to the delivery of the jewels of private individuals found in Perebebuy, and asked that there might be restored which belonged to the French subject (deceased) Pedro Anglade.
list.label: 17th.
list.item: Inquiry made with regard to Luiz Capuro and Antonio Dorignac.
list.label: 18th.
list.item: Statement of the Paraguayan generals Resquen and José Falcon.
list.label: 19th.
list.item: Statement of the Paraguayans Silvestre Aveiro, Maiioel Palacios, and of the Argentine, Victor Silveiro.
list.label: 20th.
list.item: Ditto of the priest Jivel Maiz.
list.label: 21st.
list.item: Inventory of the objects found in the possession of Eliza Alicia Lynch, and of the documents corroborative of the generous manner in which she was treated by the Brazilian authorities.
list.label: 22d.
list.item: List of those claimants who have died, of those whose fate is unknown, and of those who have given their testimony.
